name: Bead Jar
summary: A stats section where glass jars fill with glossy beads as each number counts up, year by year
about: A by-the-numbers section drawn on canvas: each stat is a glass jar on a shelf that fills to its share of the goal with glossy beads. Pick a year and the jars wobble, the lids pop, beads pour in or hop out through the neck while the numbers count, then the lids drop back with a sparkle and a chip shows the change on the year before. Tap a jar to shake it.
how: Pick 2024, 2025 or 2026 (or use the arrow keys on the tabs): a bead rolls along under the tabs to the year.
Each jar wobbles and pops its lid, then beads fall in through the neck and bounce into place, or hop out if the number dropped.
The number under each jar counts to the new value; when the jar settles, the lid drops back on and a chip shows the change.
Tap a jar (or press Enter on it) to shake it and watch the beads jump and settle again.
